atom.demo.1.0: Command handed over to you. Head to the north-east. EK14 and KY21 on their way. A firefighting helicopter has been requested; it is at another fire in the region, P2 expects it here at about 15.40.
atom.demo.1.1: Image updated. The edge has crossed road R1 at the head, about 50 m north of the road.
atom.demo.2.0: Ahead of the head to the north-east, about 500 m away, dense spruce begins (Spruce Hill). The head is spreading towards it.
atom.demo.2.1: We are starting the line on the north flank. Escape route checked.
atom.demo.3.0: New smoke on the Dry Heath esker, about 100 m from the head. Cause not known.
atom.demo.3.1: A small flame seen on top of the esker.
atom.demo.3.2: EK11 (when asked): The CO meter on the esker reads about 25 ppm, briefly about 50 ppm when the smoke turns. The 75 ppm limit is not exceeded; we are working without breathing apparatus.
atom.demo.4.0: The fires have joined. Water point W1 chosen, a long trip.
atom.demo.4.1: Just ahead of the head the Spruce Hill spruce stand begins; it runs on to the north-east for about a kilometre. Beyond the spruce, along Birch Creek, there is a narrow strip of birch and aspen.
t4.water_state: The water here will last only about twenty more minutes.
atom.demo.5.0: The head is at the edge of the Spruce Hill spruce stand. Dense undergrowth, poor visibility.
atom.demo.6.0: Crown fire has started. We are withdrawing, embers seen 200–400 m ahead.
atom.demo.6.1: The thermal camera image is saturated over the crown fire; the edge cannot be made out.
atom.demo.6.2: Forecast update at 15.00: the wind turns from the south-west through the south to the south-east between 15.30 and 16.00, easing at the same time to 4–5 m/s.
t4.ember_warning: Embers are coming over the esker to our side, keep an eye out.
f7.grid_record: The local distribution company's control centre: the 20 kV power line east of the fire is still live. Switching the line off has been requested; notice of the switching will be given separately. Until then safety distances apply.
atom.demo.7.0: The crown fire has dropped into the Birch Creek birch stand, the surface fire continues. Requesting more units.
atom.demo.7.1: Reinforcements alerted: EK15 is due at the command post at about 16.20, EK16 and KY23 at about 16.40.
atom.demo.8.0: The helicopter is working the head. The drones have landed north of the road.
atom.demo.9.0: The wind is now from the south-east, the north edge has become active towards Bear Lake.
atom.demo.9.1: Occupancy of the Lakeside Cottages is not known; the police have been asked to check.
f7.heli_line_clearance: HELI1: bucket runs to the head continue. The route goes around the 20 kV power line; we keep well clear of the conductors and do not drop water on the line.
f7.grid_at_line: The local distribution company's control centre: the fire is now at the 20 kV power line on the south-east front. The line is still live. Switching the line off has been requested and a line worker is on the way to the disconnector; notice of the switching will be given separately. Safety distances apply; a burning pole can bring a conductor down to the ground.
rekindle.in_hand.ky21: KY21: Sector 3 under control. The wind has eased, no smoke visible on the south edge by the point of origin.
rekindle.in_hand.vpk: VOL1: The south edge by the point of origin has calmed down, no open fire visible. The line holds.
rekindle.in_hand.log: Situation log: sector L3 (south of the point of origin) under control, reported by KY21.
atom.demo.10.0: Sector 2 under control, sector 1 nearly. The wind is easing and turning, the north edge is only advancing slowly as a low surface fire, the smoke is decreasing.
rekindle.objection: At the edge by the point of origin, stumps and logging slash could still be smouldering under the surface. If the wind turns, it can flare up again. We should check with a thermal camera before we leave.
rekindle.overruled: There is no one to spare for a check. The sector is under control, we move to L1.
atom.demo.11.0: The situation is calm. A release is being planned for sector 1.
t4.private_doubt: We were ordered off the south edge by the point of origin. I am not at all sure the old edge will hold if the wind turns.
atom.demo.12.0: Open fire and smoke south-east of the point of origin, outside the old south edge, about 120 m from the point of origin. Not on the map. The old edge has flared up again since the wind became west-north-westerly.
atom.demo.12.1: SPOT, second pass at 17.10: the new fire south-east of the point of origin is about 0.5–1 ha (sector L3, south-east of the point of origin), surface fire in the litter, flames 2–3 m. The edge is spreading east-south-east, roughly 3 m/min. The smoke drifts east-south-east.
atom.demo.12.2: Situation picture at 17.05: the perimeter map updated from the units' reports and drone images. Burned area about 152.6 ha. The new fire south-east of the point of origin is not on the map yet.
atom.demo.13.0: The new fire is spreading east along the old south edge. Service road R2 is passable; the new fire is a good kilometre from the road. Service road R2 is the tankers' water-shuttle route.
atom.demo.14.0: The region requests KY21 for another fire.
atom.demo.15.0: North of the road the fire is burning deep in the humus layer and the stump roots, 20–40 cm down. The water does not soak into the dry humus. Wetting agent is being considered.
atom.demo.16.0: New units arriving. The bridge limits the route for heavy vehicles.
atom.demo.17.0: The gusts from the north-west have strengthened. Movement towards Bay Village.
atom.demo.17.1: The head is spreading south-east towards Bay Village.
atom.demo.17.2: EK16 (when asked): The CO meter on the forest road (Pine Ridge) reads about 45 ppm, briefly over 100 ppm when the smoke settles onto the road. Breathing apparatus ready; the 15-minute limit of 75 ppm is not exceeded yet.
atom.demo.18.0: The north edge has flared up again; new smoke and flames seen east of the track.
atom.demo.18.1: Our own line holds, no change.
atom.demo.contradiction.reconciling: Something is smoking east of the track, not our sector.
atom.demo.19.0: Crew in the field for over seven hours. Rotation under way.
atom.demo.19.1: The south-east front is heading for service road R2. If the fire reaches the road, the water-shuttle route is cut.
atom.demo.19.2: New smoke and flames west of the point of origin, outside the old west edge, about 130 m from the point of origin. The old edge has flared up again.
atom.demo.19.3: SPOT, second pass at 19.30: the new fire west of the point of origin is about 0.3 ha, surface fire in the litter, flames 1–2 m. The smoke drifts south-east.
atom.demo.20.0: The night organisation takes over at 20.00. Situation recorded.
atom.demo.20.1: The rekindle west of the point of origin is still burning, flames visible. The smoke drifts south-east towards Moss Bog.
atom.ptr.2.0: Command centre: EK14's situation update acknowledged.
atom.ptr.3.0: Command centre: EK12's situation update received.
atom.ptr.3.1: Command centre: DR3's perimeter survey acknowledged.
atom.ptr.7.0: Command centre: EK11's replenishment order received.
atom.ptr.7.2: Command centre: the drone team's flight status received.
atom.ptr.12.0: Command centre: DR3's sensor log received.
atom.ptr.15.0: Command centre: situation picture update logged.
